AppFunctionAppMetadata.appfn:description: Grocery shopping list app (German: Einkaufsliste). Users ask things like 'Setz Milch und Brot auf die Einkaufsliste' or 'Was steht auf meiner Einkaufsliste?'. Operational Patterns: - To add products call 'addItems' with one list entry per product. Keep quantities inside the entry text, for example '2 Liter Milch' or '6 Eier'. - To answer questions about the list call 'getShoppingList'. - To mark something as bought call 'checkOffItem' with the product name. Constraints: - Product names are usually German; keep the user's wording.
